query:
UPDATE house_races SET
  notes = 'Primary suspended due to Supreme Court ruling in Louisiana v. Callais (April 2026), which found the 2024 redistricting map illegally used racial demographics. Louisiana''s state Senate passed a new map that would eliminate one of the two Black-majority districts. House primaries will be rescheduled once the new map is finalized and any litigation is resolved.',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE state_code = 'LA';
